3 باطشهُ , (S, TA,) inf. n. مُبَاطَشَةٌ (S, K) and بِطَاشٌ, (TA,) He laboured, strove, struggled, contended, or conflicted, with him, to prevail, or overcome; syn. of the inf. n. مُعَالَجَةٌ. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- بَاطَشَا, (TK,) inf. n. مُبَاطَشَةٌ, (K,) Each of them two stretched forth his hand towards the other to seize him violently (K, TA) and to assault him quickly. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
